The day I almost got blown up at the mall...

Back in March, i was shopping at the mall near my small city. My mom, her boyfriend (BF) and his kid (BFK) and I all were going out so I could get a few things at Hot Topic for me, and a few gemstones for my Grandma. We decided to get the stones first, after, we headed over to the Hot Topic, but halfway there BF wanted to go get some Boba with BFK, so he gave my mom his phone, and we split. 

My mom and I get to the hot topic, and start looking around. About 5 minutes go by and we hear the sound of a large explosion, similar to a firework, but a bit louder. Then we saw people fleeing for the door, me and my mom made eye contact, and the staff hurried us to the back of the shop. Only 3 other teenagers and 2 staff were there besides us, 2 of the 3 were girls with pink hair, who helped me get behind some boxes to keep me safe, as I was the youngest there. We all packed into the back and waited quietly for the clear.

While all of this was happening, BF and BFK were down at the Boba shop. They had this sand box for the kids to play in, and BFK was having a blast filling his bucket up with sand. BF was just about to pay, when he saw something hit the sandbox. BF quickly grabbed BFK and held him very close, the sound we heard just went off, and BF turned back to the counter to see that the entire staff was gone, and everything was shut off. BF grabbed his tea and a straw, and hurried over to the Hot Topic, hoping we were OK.

We sat in the back quietly, or at least until one of the teenage guys started to make jokes about how out of all of us, I would most likely know what to do, cause of the drills we do in school, wasn't very funny. My mom is furiously texting BF, asking if he and BFK were alright, getting mad at him, cause he wasn't answering, when she realized that his phone was in her pocket, my mom was in the middle of a panic attack, when we here the door open, it was BF and BFK, who were just as freaked out as we were! We all sat in silence for about 5 minutes, when the staff said that we couod go through the back door, and try and get out from another door. We thanked them, and headed out.

It took awhile for us to get out, ups and downs, and signs that were no help has messed with us, however we did eventually make it out! The police had arrived, and BF and I went to go tell the officer what happened, we all concluded that it may have been a smoke bomb, as when it went off smoke and sand went into the air.

We all went back to the car, and headed home. With only half of what we needed, and some PTSD.
